entities.summary: Alexander G. Argyropoulos (1883–1962) was a Greek ambassador. Born in London, he was the son of the Greek ambassador to the United Kingdom. He trained as an agricultural engineer. In his spare time he was a noted philatelist. From 1952 to 1956, he was Greek Ambassador to Italy.
